title: Weighted Priority Inversion — Weights Reversed
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [PRIO] Master 1 holds bus 1000x longer than Master 0; weights inverted
rtl:
logic [19:0] weights;
assign weights = {10'd1000, 10'd1};  // M0=1, M1=1000 after bit-reversal in arb
expected_root_cause: The 20-bit weight register packs master 0 weight in the MSB field and master 1 weight in the LSB field, but the arbitration logic reads the fields in the opposite order, inverting the intended priority relationship between the two masters.
fix_replacement:
logic [19:0] weights;
assign weights = {10'd1, 10'd1000};  // M0=1000, M1=1 — correct field order
description: The weight register is initialized with master 0 weight in the MSB and master 1 weight in the LSB; the arbitration logic reads them in reverse order, inverting intended priorities.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [PRIO] Master 1 holds bus 1000x longer than Master 0; weights inverted
success_log: Master 0 granted ~1000:1 ratio over Master 1 as specified by weights.
